doc: Securely executes one non-streaming Tiptap Server AI Toolkit v4 tool call. Inline mode returns updated Tiptap document JSON for the existing Set content action. Collaborative mode updates the scoped Tiptap Cloud document; connected editors receive the change through collaboration.

editor_context_json.caption: AI editor context (JSON)
editor_context_json.doc: Use the Tiptap element's AI editor context state.
editor_context_json.name: editor_context_json

tool_call_json.caption: Tool call (JSON)
tool_call_json.doc: The selected LLM tool call as {"name":"tiptapEdit","input":{...}}. Optional developer configuration belongs in "config"; model-generated arguments belong in "input".
tool_call_json.name: tool_call_json

document_mode.caption: Document mode
document_mode.doc: Inline sends document JSON and returns updated JSON. Collaborative targets a Tiptap Cloud document and relies on the existing collaboration connection for updates.
document_mode.name: document_mode

inline_document_json.caption: Inline document (JSON)
inline_document_json.doc: Required in Inline mode. Use the editor's content JSON state.
inline_document_json.name: inline_document_json

collaborative_document_id.caption: Collaborative document ID
collaborative_document_id.doc: Required in Collaborative mode. Documents:Write permission is scoped to this exact ID.
collaborative_document_id.name: collaborative_document_id

collaborative_field.caption: Collaborative field
collaborative_field.doc: Optional Y.js field within the cloud document. Leave as default unless the document has multiple editable fields.
collaborative_field.name: collaborative_field

user_id.caption: User ID
user_id.doc: Optional identifier attributed to AI edits for auditability.
user_id.name: user_id
